paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THESE fires associate with Indra are awake, bringing their light when first the Dawn begins to shine.
paragraphs.original: अबुध्रमु त्य इन्द्रवन्तो अग्नयो ज्योतिर्भरन्त उषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
paragraphs.translit: abudhramu tya indravanto agnayo jyotirbharanta uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu |

paragraphs.text: May Heaven and Earth, great Pair, observe our holy work. We claim for us this day the favour of the Gods.
paragraphs.original: मही द्यावापृथिवी चेततामपोऽद्या देवानामव आ वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: mahī dyāvāpṛthivī cetatāmapo'dyā devānāmava ā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 2. Yea, for ourselves we claim the grace of Heaven and Earth, of Saryanavan, of the Hills and Mother Streams.
paragraphs.original: दिवस्पृथिव्योरव आ वृणीमहे मातॄन्सिन्धून्पर्वताञ्छर्यणावतः ।
paragraphs.translit: divaspṛthivyorava ā vṛṇīmahe mātṝnsindhūnparvatāñcharyaṇāvataḥ |

paragraphs.text: For innocence we pray to Surya and to Dawn. So may the flowing Soma bring us bliss to-day.
paragraphs.original: अनागास्त्वं सूर्यमुषासमीमहे भद्रं सोमः सुवानो अद्या कृणोतु नः
paragraphs.translit: anāgāstvaṃ sūryamuṣāsamīmahe bhadraṃ somaḥ suvāno adyā kṛṇotu naḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. May the great Twain, the Mothers, Heaven and Earth, this day preserve us free from sin for peace and happiness.
paragraphs.original: द्यावा नो अद्य पृथिवी अनागसो मही त्रायेतां सुविताय मातरा ।
paragraphs.translit: dyāvā no adya pṛthivī anāgaso mahī trāyetāṃ suvitāya mātarā |

paragraphs.text: May Morning sending forth her light drive sin afar. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: उषा उच्छन्त्यप बाधतामघं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: uṣā ucchantyapa bādhatāmaghaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 4. May this first Dawn bring us the host of gracious Gods: rich, may it richly shine for us who strive for wealth.
paragraphs.original: इयं न उस्रा प्रथमा सुदेव्यं रेवत्सनिभ्यो रेवती व्युच्छतु ।
paragraphs.translit: iyaṃ na usrā prathamā sudevyaṃ revatsanibhyo revatī vyucchatu |

paragraphs.text: The wrath of the malignant may we keep afar. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: आरे मन्युं दुर्विदत्रस्य धीमहि स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: āre manyuṃ durvidatrasya dhīmahi svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 5. Dawns, who come forward with the bright beams of the Sun, and at your earliest flushing bring to us the light,
paragraphs.original: प्र याः सिस्रते सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्ज्योतिर्भरन्तीरुषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
paragraphs.translit: pra yāḥ sisrate sūryasya raśmibhirjyotirbharantīruṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu |

paragraphs.text: Shine ye on us to-day auspicious, for renown. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: भद्रा नो अद्य श्रवसे व्युच्छत स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: bhadrā no adya śravase vyucchata svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 6. Free from all sickness may the Mornings come to us, and let our fires mount upward with a lofty blaze.
paragraphs.original: अनमीवा उषस आ चरन्तु न उदग्नयो जिहतां ज्योतिषा बृहत् ।
paragraphs.translit: anamīvā uṣasa ā carantu na udagnayo jihatāṃ jyotiṣā bṛhat |

paragraphs.text: The Asvin Pair have harnessed their swift-moving car. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: आयुक्षातामश्विना तूतुजिं रथं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: āyukṣātāmaśvinā tūtujiṃ rathaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 7. Send us to-day a portion choice and excellent, O Savitar, for thou art he who dealeth wealth.
paragraphs.original: श्रेष्ठं नो अद्य सवितर्वरेण्यं भागमा सुव स हि रत्नधा असि ।
paragraphs.translit: śreṣṭhaṃ no adya savitarvareṇyaṃ bhāgamā suva sa hi ratnadhā asi |

paragraphs.text: I cry to Dhisana, Mother of opulence. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: रायो जनित्रीं धिषणामुप ब्रुवे स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: rāyo janitrīṃ dhiṣaṇāmupa bruve svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 8. Further me this declaring of Eternal Law, the Law of Gods, as we mortals acknowledge it!
paragraphs.original: पिपर्तु मा तदृतस्य प्रवाचनं देवानां यन्मनुष्या अमन्महि ।
paragraphs.translit: pipartu mā tadṛtasya pravācanaṃ devānāṃ yanmanuṣyā amanmahi |

paragraphs.text: The Sun goes up beholding all the rays of morn. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: विश्वा इदुस्रा स्पळुदेति सूर्यः स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: viśvā idusrā spaḷudeti sūryaḥ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 9. This day we pray with innocence in strewing grass, adjusting pressing-stones, and perfecting the hymn.
paragraphs.original: अद्वेषो अद्य बर्हिष स्तरीमणि ग्राव्णां योगे मन्मनः साध ईमहे ।
paragraphs.translit: adveṣo adya barhiṣa starīmaṇi grāvṇāṃ yoge manmanaḥ sādha īmahe |

paragraphs.text: Thou in the Adityas' keeping movest restlessly. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: आदित्यानां शर्मणि स्था भुरण्यसि स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: ādityānāṃ śarmaṇi sthā bhuraṇyasi svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 10. To our great holy grass I bid the Gods at morn to banquet, and will seat them as the seven priests,-
paragraphs.original: आ नो बर्हिः सधमादे बृहद्दिवि देवाँ ईळे सादया सप्त होतॄन् ।
paragraphs.translit: ā no barhiḥ sadhamāde bṛhaddivi devām̐ īḷe sādayā sapta hotṝn |

paragraphs.text: Varuna, Indra, Mitra, Bhaga for our gain. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 11. Come hither, O Adityas, for our perfect weal: accordant help our sacrifice that we may thrive.
paragraphs.original: त आदित्या आ गता सर्वतातये वृधे नो यज्ञमवता सजोषसः ।
paragraphs.translit: ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye vṛdhe no yajñamavatā sajoṣasaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Pusan, Brhaspati, Bhaga, both Asvins, and enkindled Agni we implore for happiness.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिं पूषणमश्विना भगं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiṃ pūṣaṇamaśvinā bhagaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 12. Adityas, Gods, vouchsafe that this our home may be praise-worthy, prosperous, our heroes' sure defence,
paragraphs.original: तन्नो देवा यच्छत सुप्रवाचनं छर्दिरादित्याः सुभरं नृपाय्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tanno devā yacchata supravācanaṃ chardirādityāḥ subharaṃ nṛpāyyam |

paragraphs.text: For cattle, for our sons, for progeny, for life. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.
paragraphs.original: पश्वे तोकाय तनयाय जीवसे स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: paśve tokāya tanayāya jīvase svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 13. This day may all the Maruts, all he near us with aid: may all our fires be well enkindled.
paragraphs.original: विश्वे अद्य मरुतो विश्व ऊती विश्वे भवन्त्वग्नयः समिद्धाः ।
paragraphs.translit: viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ |

paragraphs.text: May all Gods come to us with gracious favour. May spoil and wealth he ours, and all possessions.
paragraphs.original: विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्तु विश्वमस्तु द्रविणं वाजो अस्मे
paragraphs.translit: viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme

paragraphs.text: 14. He whom ye aid, O Deities, in battle, whom ye protect and rescue from affliction,
paragraphs.original: यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं त्रायध्वे यं पिपृथात्यंहः ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ trāyadhve yaṃ pipṛthātyaṃhaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Who fears no danger at your milk-libation, -such may we be to feast the Gods, ye Mighty.
paragraphs.original: यो वो गोपीथे न भयस्य वेद ते स्याम देववीतये तुरासः
paragraphs.translit: yo vo gopīthe na bhayasya veda te syāma devavītaye turāsaḥ
